say:2:1221311001:1.text:
This one?
Hammie, do you want to make the elixir?
say:2:1221311001:1.source_cn: 就是这口锅了吧！\n漫漫，你来制作药水吗？

say:3:1221311002:1.text: I'd love to, but the elixir is for the Magister... I—I'm afraid I might mess up.
say:3:1221311002:1.source_cn: 我是很想自己来，可是一想到这瓶药水要给梅林喝……我、我...

say:4:1221311003:1.text: That's true. We just aren't cut out for this kind of task with our tiny hands!
say:4:1221311003:1.source_cn: 唔，也是，我们这种小短手确实很不方便！

document:9:49:0.text:
Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Foxtail grass</style> grown in the shade and unripe fruit of <style="highlight">tune sprouts</style>.

Put the materials in a pot, add water, and simmer over high heat until the liquid is entirely clear.

Reminder: Consume quickly! Otherwise, the potency of the medicine will decrease over time!
document:9:49:0.source_cn:
原材料：<style="highlight">长在阴影里的狸尾草</style>、<style="highlight">琴豆木的青涩果实</style>，制作方法：将原材料放进锅里，加水大火熬煮，直至液体完全清澈。
注意：尽快服用！否则药效会逐渐流失！

say:18:1221311011:1.text: So, this is the memory elixir... The shimmering liquid seems to hold a powerful magical force!
say:18:1221311011:1.source_cn: 这就是记忆药水……看起来亮晶晶的，像是蕴含着很神奇的魔力！

say:19:1221311012:1.text: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!
say:19:1221311012:1.source_cn: 主人，赶快喝下去试试吧，说不定马上就能恢复记忆了！
say:19:1221311012:1.male: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!

narration:23:1221311015:0.text: Maybe the elixir really works, or maybe it just tastes too awful. Either way, memories after you woke up at the Mystical House flash quickly before your eyes, and you even recall some long-forgotten details...
narration:23:1221311015:0.source_cn: 不知道是因为记忆药水的确有用，还是因为它太难喝，从神秘...

say:26:1221311017:0.text: Chippy's so relieved! You gave us such a fright just now!
say:26:1221311017:0.source_cn: 主人醒过来了就好！刚才真是吓坏我们了！
say:26:1221311017:0.male: Chippy's so relieved! You gave us such a fright just now!
say:26:1221311017:0.female: Chippy's so relieved! You gave us such a fright just now!

say:28:1221311018:1.text: How are you feeling, Magister? Do you remember anything from before?
say:28:1221311018:1.source_cn: 梅林，你感觉怎么样？有没有想起之前的事？
say:28:1221311018:1.male: How are you feeling, Magister? Do you remember anything from before?

say:31:1221311026:1.text: Indeed... Why didn't that elixir work at all? Could the glimmerbloom's recipe have been wrong?
say:31:1221311026:1.source_cn: 是啊……那瓶记忆药水为什么一点作用也没有？难道荧荧花给...

choice_prompt:32:1221311026.text: Indeed... Why didn't that elixir work at all? Could the glimmerbloom's recipe have been wrong?
choice_prompt:32:1221311026.source_cn: 是啊……那瓶记忆药水为什么一点作用也没有？难道荧荧花给的配方是错的？

say:33:1221311027:1.text: Does this elixir only help bring back details of things one already remembers?
say:33:1221311027:1.source_cn: 难道这瓶药水的效果，只是让人回忆起一些已经记得的事的小...

say:34:1221311028:1.text: W—What kind of a memory elixir is this? I say it's an outright scam!
say:34:1221311028:1.source_cn: 这、这算什么恢复记忆的药水啊！根本就是骗人嘛！

say:35:1221311029:1.text: We can't blame those glimmerblooms, as they're just trying to help me. The true recipe is too elusive, and making the elixir is even more challenging.
say:35:1221311029:1.source_cn: 也不能怪那些荧荧花，它们是想帮我，只是记忆药水的配方确...

say:36:1221311030:1.text: Actually, the elixir isn't completely useless; it just doesn't have the effect we expected.
say:36:1221311030:1.source_cn: 而且，这瓶药水也不是完全没效果，只是和我们想象中不太一...

say:37:1221311031:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, don't worry! I'll work even harder to find other solutions!

say:44:1221311024:1.source_cn: 真的吗……？你真的没有失忆？太好了！
say:44:1221311024:1.male: Really? You haven't lost your memory? Thank goodness!

say:45:1221311025:1.text: You don't seem to have recovered your memory either...
say:45:1221311025:1.source_cn: 不过看你的样子，好像也没有恢复记忆……
say:45:1221311025:1.male: You don't seem to have recovered your memory either...

choice:42:0:1.text: Hold back your tears. I was just messing with you.
choice:42:0:1.male: Hold back your tears. I was just messing with you.
choice:42:0:1.female: Hold back your tears. I was just messing with you.

choice:29:1:2.male: Who are you? Do I know you?
choice:29:1:2.female: Who are you? Do I know you?

say:46:1221311007:1.text: I-I really appreciate that, but no kidding, I might end up making something weird...
say:46:1221311007:1.source_cn: 虽、虽然很感谢你愿意相信我，但我真的很怕自己会做出一瓶...

say:47:1221311008:1.text: So... I think it's best if you take care of it yourself.

say:47:1221311008:1.male: So... I think it's best if you take care of it yourself.
